row.commencement_note: The Act commenced on 01.01.1964. Its application to IBC applications under ss.7 and 9 comes through IBC s.238A (inserted w.e.f. 06.06.2018), which the Supreme Court has applied also to applications filed before that date; whether to key this row from 1964 or 06.06.2018 is for the reviewer. The period runs 'when the right to apply accrues' (for IBC, the date of default): that is the DEFAULT key date the checker uses.
